content.comment_body: I'm using Stuffit Expander version 16.2 to open the setup.zip file. Stuffit Expander appears to run but does not produce an output file like setup.app. When I use Unarchiver, it generates a setup.app file, but attempting to open it results in the message: "setup.app is damaged and can't be opened, move to trash bin or cancel." Choosing 'show contents' reveals the folder structure and a file called setup, but running the setup file leads to the same error. How can I install [version_no] 8.4? Installing 8.2 and 8.3 worked fine, and I’ve tried installing 8.4 both with and without previous versions. // [user_name]

I'm facing the same issue. I tried installing [product_name] [version_no] 8.4 using Unarchiver. Have you managed to fix this, or is there a way to get version 8.3 instead? I couldn't find any link for it.
[company_name] has removed all downloads for version 8.3.x. Why? I’m not sure.
Is there any possibility to obtain older setup files from sources other than [company_name]?
You received no reply; that doesn't seem right.
Alright, my mistake. Is there a fix for installation issues with version 8.4?
The online help for [product_name] [version_no] 8.4 suggests: Start a support request. Perhaps [company_name] can assist you.

In the meantime, I managed to install 8.4 on macOS Sonoma 14.2.1; - Extract setup.zip - Enter setup.app folder and locate the Setup executable - Run "chmod a+x Setup" - Execute "./Setup" (though it fails due to a damaged file error) - Run "sudo xattr -c Setup" - Allow Setup to execute via System Settings > Privacy and Security

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering major installation challenges with [product_name] [version_no] 8.4 on macOS, specifically an error stating the installer is damaged and cannot be opened. Previous versions (8.2, 8.3) installed smoothly, suggesting that 8.4 has compatibility issues with newer macOS releases. Multiple extraction tools and workarounds have been tried without success, creating a significant barrier to installation.
